title.narrative: Fondo per assistenza alla partecipazione alla Cabina di Regia Piano Mattei ed attività connesse al coinvolgimento degli attori del Sistema Italia
Fund for assistance in participating in the Piano Mattei Steering Committee and activities related to the involvement of Italian System actors

description.narrative: L’iniziativa mira a garantire agli Uffici, alle Vice Direzioni e alla Direzione dell’Agenzia Italiana per la Cooperazione allo Sviluppo (AICS), la necessaria assistenza tecnica, amministrativo-contabile, l’efficace e piena attuazione delle politiche di cooperazione allo sviluppo di competenza AICS, nonché il perseguimento degli interessi pubblici affidati alla sua mission istituzionale, anche in previsione di quanto disposto dal D.L. n. 161/2023 (convertito in Legge n. 2/2024) recante disciplina della governance del cosiddetto “Piano Mattei”. Il coinvolgimento dell’AICS nella Cabina di Regia del Piano Mattei (art. 2 del DL n. 161/2023), così come l’esposizione sempre più ampia verso iniziative e fondi promossi e messi a disposizione dalla Commissione europea e sue delegazioni nei Paesi partner, comporterà nell’immediato futuro, la necessità di rafforzare e supportare la capacità tecnico-amministrativa dell’Agenzia, assicurando adeguati standard qualitativi - a fronte di un carico quantitativo costantemente crescente - in tutti gli ambiti e le tipologie di intervento, in linea con i migliori standard nazionali, europei e internazionali. In particolare, l’Iniziativa vuole assicurare l’assistenza amministrativa per l’espletamento del Bando 2023 per OSC ed Enti territoriali, l’assistenza tecnica e il supporto alla gestione delle attività collegate all’attuazione del «Piano Mattei» per lo sviluppo in Paesi del Continente africano, nonché a sostegno del Sistema Italiano di Cooperazione allo Sviluppo, oltre al supporto specialistico nell’ambito delle relazioni istituzionali e attività di comunicazione collegate alle suddette attività, oltre alla capacità di fornire ed elaborare analisi statistiche di qualità.

The initiative aims at guaranteeing the Offices and Units of the of the Italian Agency for Development Cooperation (AICS), the Vice Technical and Administrative Directorates (henceforth VDT/VDA) e the General Director the necessary technical, administrative and accounting assistance, the effective and full implementation of the development cooperation policies falling within the competence of the Agency as well as the pursuit of the public interests entrusted to its institutional mission, also in coherence with the provisions of the so called “Piano Mattei” (henceforth, Mattei Plan - D. L. no. 161/2023. converted into L. no. 2/2024). The Agency involvement within the “Cabina di Regia” of the Mattei Plan (art. 2 DL no.161/2023) , as well as the increasingly broad exposure to initiatives and funds promoted and made available by the European Commission and its delegations in Partner countries, will lead to the need to strengthen and support the technical-administrative capacity of the Agency. Thus, it is necessary to strengthen the capacity of the Agency's Offices, ensuring adequate quality standards - in the face of a constantly growing quantitative load - in all spheres and types of intervention, in line with the best national, European and international standards. In particular, the Initiative intends to ensure administrative assistance for the procedure embedded in the Call for Proposals 2023 for CSOs and territorial Entities, technical assistance and support for the management of activities connected to the implementation of the Mattei Plan and its development in African countries, as well as in support of the Italian Development Cooperation System, in addition to a qualified support both in the field of institutional relations and communication activities, and in the ability to provide and process quality statistical analyses required by the above-mentioned Piano Mattei.

tag.narrative: By 2030, build on existing initiatives to develop measurements of progress on sustainable development that complement gross domestic product, and support statistical capacity-building in developing countries

Enhance North-South, South-South and triangular regional and international cooperation on and access to science, technology and innovation and enhance knowledge-sharing on mutually agreed terms, including through improved coordination among existing mechanisms, in particular at the United Nations level, and through a global technology facilitation mechanism

Enhance the Global Partnership for Sustainable Development, complemented by multi-stakeholder partnerships that mobilize and share knowledge, expertise, technology and financial resources, to support the achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals in all countries, in particular developing countries
Mobilize additional financial resources for developing countries from multiple sources
Strengthen the means of implementation and revitalize the global partnership for sustainable development
